title: Promissory note hash chain v1
description: The per-note hash chain (docs/specs/promissory-notes.md, build step 3): one link per event in recording order (seq), and the head that a note.chain-seal signs. event_hash is sha256 of the event's canonical JSON; prev_hash is the genesis hash (sha256 of 'tfd.note-chain.v1:' and the note id) on link 1, else sha256 of the previous link's canonical JSON ({event_hash, event_id, prev_hash, seq}). The chain orders by seq only; value_date and entered_at are never read. Whether the hashes are right is checked in code (src/chain.ts, verifyChain), not by this schema.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: All links of one note, link n at index n - 1.
